wine_prefix.description: The path to the Wine prefix directory where Windows programs and registry are stored.

wine_debug.description: Wine debugging flags. Examples: 'warn+all', 'err+all,fixme-all', 'relay'. See man page for syntax.

wine_arch.description: The Windows architecture to support. 'win32' for 32-bit only, 'win64' for 64-bit with WoW64 support.

win_dll_overrides.description: List of DLL override configurations to prepend to the default list. Each item is a string in format 'dlls=n,b' or 'dlls=b,n'. See man page for details on native (n) vs builtin (b). This is used to build the WINEDLLOVERRIDES variable alongside defaults if needed, but primarily this allows defining specific overrides.

wine_d3d_config.description: List of Direct3D configuration key-value pairs (e.g., 'renderer=vulkan'). These will be joined with ';' to form the WINE_D3D_CONFIG variable.

wine_path_extra.description: Additional Windows-style paths to prepend to the Windows PATH environment variable.
